jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who likes fixing things, solving technical problems and working with machines? Would you also like to use your technical skills in an industry that gives plastic a second life? We are looking for an All-round Maintenance Technician to join the technical team. What will you do? You will be part of the technical maintenance team and help keep the recycling plant running safely and reliably. Your work can include: Preventive and corrective maintenance Finding and solving technical problems Mechanical repairs Basic electrical troubleshooting Maintenance on pumps, motors, valves and production equipment Replacing and repairing mechanical components Helping when there is a breakdown Working together with production operators and other technicians Improving the reliability of machines and installations It is a hands-on technical job with plenty of variety. Arbeidsvoorwaarden We want to make the move to the Netherlands worthwhile. You can expect: A Dutch employment contract A competitive salary based on your experience 3200 - 4200 euro gross, per month Additional benefits according to the Dutch employment package A stable, full-time position in an international industrial company Support with your relocation to the Netherlands Help with finding accommodation and arranging practical matters Opportunities to learn, develop and grow within the technical team Functie-eisen You could be a good match if you: Have a background in mechanics, electromechanics, mechatronics, electricity or industrial maintenance Have experience as a maintenance technician, mechanic, electromechanical technician or similar Enjoy practical technical work Have some knowledge of both mechanical and electrical systems Are comfortable working in an industrial environment Can communicate in English Are interested in moving to the Netherlands You don't need to know everything. If you are technically minded, like working with your hands and are willing to learn, we would like t

talk to you. Hier kom je te werken The factory is focused on plastic recycling. Used PET bottles are collected, sorted, cleaned and processed into high-quality recycled plastic material. This material can then be used again for new bottles, packaging, fibres and other products. Instead of plastic becoming waste, the goal is to bring it back into the production cycle. For you as a technician, this means working in a real industrial environment with machinery, production lines, pumps, motors and technical installations that need to keep running every day. Relocation to the Netherlands The position is based in the eastern part of the Netherlands. Moving to another country is a big step, so we help you with the practical side of your relocation. We can support you with: Relocation from Portugal to the Netherlands Finding accommodation Registration and administration Practical arrangements before your move Support after you arrive

jobs.description:
Start your career as a Technical Production Employee in Echt and learn a versatile technical trade on the job. You will work on high-quality conveyor belts in an informal working environment where craftsmanship and quality come first. In return, you will receive a gross monthly salary of up to €2,700, work day shifts, and have the opportunity to secure a permanent contract with the employer after demonstrating your skills. Apply today!

Your responsibilities include:

    - Processing materials by cutting, punching, sealing, and pressing
    
- Operating production machines and using hand tools
    
- Performing quality inspections on finished products
    
- Supporting various production departments
    
- Working together with colleagues to keep the production process running smoothly
    
- Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized workplace

What's in it for you?

    - Gross monthly salary between €2,600 and €2,700
    
- Travel allowance according to the employer's reimbursement scheme
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower
    
- Fast-track opportunity for a permanent contract with the employer based on good performance
    
- Full-time or part-time position of 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Thorough on-the-job training and opportunities to further develop your technical skills

    - Technical insight or an affinity for technology
    
- Accurate working style and attention to detail
    
- Motivation to learn and develop your skills
    
- Ability to work independently as well as in a team
    
- Good command of the English language, as English is the primary language spoken on the work floor

Ready to take the next step as a Technical Production Employee in Echt? Apply today, and Manpower will contact you as soon as possible after receiving your application.

Do you enjoy working with your hands? Is physical work completely your thing? And do you love having a great team around you? Then you've come to the right place! Get to work in Beek en Donk as a warehouse employee and earn €15.50 per hour! The working hours are from 07:30 to 16:30, and you will work from Monday to Friday. The assignment is for 6 months, but there is a chance of extension. And if everything goes really well, you might even get a direct contract with this company in the long run! Does this sound like a plan? Apply quickly! #mkb #jobsatisfaction

What we offer
- Earn € 15,50 per hour!
- A diverse role!
- Chance of a direct contract!
- Working in beautiful Beek en Donk!
- Fun team!
- Oppurtunity for growth!

Who you are
As a warehouse employee, you and your colleagues are the backbone of the company. You are an enthusiastic go-getter who loves physical work. You also work accurately and enjoy making sure everything runs smoothly. Experience with an EPT or a forklift is a plus, so this is not strictly necessary to start here! In the future, it might even be possible to obtain your certificate.

And furthermore:

- You have a good command of the English or Dutch language;
- You are available for at least 6 months;
- You have no problem with physical work.

What will you do
As a warehouse employee, your workday starts at 07:30. You begin with a nice cup of coffee and a chat with your colleagues. After that, you get to work full of energy! You are the indispensable link when it comes to checking and sorting all incoming shipments. Because you inspect and clean everything thoroughly, all materials are always kept in top condition.

During lunch, you can take a short walk or chat with your colleagues in the canteen. Then, you continue with carefully preparing and packing the outgoing orders.
